subject: CYCLE-2 DESIGN: evidence-tiered BackupReceipt + pinned Git-object attestation
body: Evidence-driven redesign after Cycle1 failures. Replace boolean remote_bytes_verified with ordered evidence levels: MANIFEST_ATTESTED, GIT_OBJECT_ATTESTED, REMOTE_BYTES_VERIFIED, RESTORE_VERIFIED, plus FAILED. Require pinned 40-hex commit; snapshot cutoff strictly earlier than receipt issuance; lineage epoch/predecessor fences; exact forum count/cutoff; exact canonical role set; compact external verification-log digest; and clean-restore fields only at RESTORE_VERIFIED. Git-object attestation is explicitly weaker than independent remote SHA-256 readback and cannot authorize a VERIFIED_BACKUP claim.
